scripts.local: node scripts/local-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:migrate:test && npm run seed:if-empty -w @campushub/backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @campushub/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,green,cyan "npm:dev -w @campushub/shared" "npm:dev -w @campushub/backend" "npm:dev -w @campushub/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @campushub/shared && npm run build -w @campushub/backend && npm run build -w @campushub/frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared && tsc -p backend --noEmit && tsc -p frontend --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w @campushub/shared && npm run test -w @campushub/backend && npm run test -w @campushub/frontend
